sources.query: GRAPH PaysimGraph MATCH (t:transaction) RETURN COUNT(*) AS landed
GRAPH PaysimGraph MATCH (t:transaction) RETURN SUM(FLOAT64(t.amount)) AS volume, COUNTIF(BOOL(t.isfraud)) AS fraud_txns, SUM(IF(BOOL(t.isfraud), FLOAT64(t.amount), 0)) AS fraud_volume
GRAPH PaysimGraph MATCH (t:transaction) RETURN STRING(t.action) AS action, COUNT(*) AS txns

GRAPH PaysimGraph MATCH (c:client)-[:performs]->(t:transaction) WHERE BOOL(t.isfraud) RETURN STRING(c.name) AS sender, STRING(t.action) AS action, FLOAT64(t.amount) AS amount, STRING(t.timestamp) AS ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 12

widgets.title: What you are watching
widgets.text:
Every number here is one GQL query against Spanner Omni, re-run every 2 seconds.

There is no second store and no cache: `./gxr stream up` replays 12,033 transactions through Kafka, and the sink writes a `:transaction` node and two edges per event. The KPIs climb because the graph is growing underneath them — the whole replay takes about two minutes.

The actors never move — clients, merchants, banks and identifiers were loaded once by `./gxr up`. What streams is the 88% of the graph that is transactions.
